result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd shortlist **BambooHR, Employment Hero, Breathe HR, HiBob and Rippling**\.

However, the best choice depends on whether you want a straightforward HR system to manage employees or a more comprehensive platform covering the entire employee lifecycle.

Assuming you're a UK-based small business, here are my recommendations.

## Best HR software for small companies

![HR Software for UK SMEs – Trusted by 17,000+ organisations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ROJAyOfUjHKEuFBNF1pHBPQHM0PLuIvCK0q8KQmZrpoEEyCHgmWjxWwAG_Ie8huEC0fFM24TmHCcpJtbR20JLvAHxGrWA4a6X3g_walj1XXFjcLPUM-k569UTN3Z62cwoEkeqnSg04nvlm5wphVNQ53Z9B30NqsDUYyfVczvoF43_i0QLqIID3NrWQR4SDCe?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Breathe HR**

(Best for smaller UK companies)

Simple, practical HR software for employee records, holiday management, absence tracking, onboarding and performance reviews.

Ideal for companies wanting to professionalise HR without unnecessary complexity.

[Breathe HR website](https://www.breathehr.com/)

---

![2025 Employment Hero Annual Jobs Report Reveals a Workforce Under Pressure, On the Move, and Rewriting the Rules](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c72cfBM-wnkCY2sXvC-N2bdeXlozX_a6cLpeiRcNWIdO5skRSiJsO0H69D4TjL37larxeB9RHeRje9o33vXlesf4SGbT2cKN9yyK2lD71zg8gVLQUlVbvzPmQ7XZL_7bga6vNjcRIhuVAHDdb80aC6efbG65m_LmQQnOM37zl4ReRd-YURSotCy3M4QrvYQn?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best all-round platform)

HR, employee onboarding, payroll, recruitment, performance management, employee engagement and workforce management.

Good for companies wanting to bring multiple HR processes together.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BambooHR**

(Best for employee management)

Excellent for employee records, onboarding, reporting, performance management and managing the employee lifecycle.

Particularly good if you want a polished, user-friendly HR system.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![CIPD Festival of Work 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5uRyCVFXTLopovDsPtSjuuu7XX9F-BJi01QUPCXHMdmnjXLbzYZ0_7fiqRJ557qEOYiPKm0lSDmShoh9Hv0KmiYCiEJR5i1DMTBBveTrsOX3WXgPsfEuIfeEnXbp8TQpTL6sic8kIvmDY-HbAGcJP6BlMY3-bXpMo1b03otLRLw88w0gEHrv-3kpxciZR4f0?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. HiBob**

(Best for growing companies)

Modern HR platform with employee engagement, performance management, onboarding, organisational charts and people analytics.

Particularly useful as a company grows and develops a more structured HR function.

[HiBob website](https://www.hibob.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

Combines HR, payroll, employee administration and IT management, including app and device provisioning.

Better suited to businesses wanting extensive automation and room to scale.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

These choices reflect the different strengths identified in recent 2026 HR software comparisons. ## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down as follows\:

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple HR administration | Breathe HR |
| All-round HR platform | Employment Hero |
| Employee records and processes | BambooHR |
| Employee engagement and growth | HiBob |
| Automation and integrations | Rippling |


## A few questions to find the best fit

The biggest difference is often the size of the company and how much HR functionality you actually need.
